measurements.method: Existing native Vision FaceAlignment executable on twelve sampled frames per clip. Eye midpoint for 2D image translation, eye-line angle for in-plane roll. Displacement normalized by each clip's median eye separation.
measurements.interpretation: K has substantially more sampled head-image movement than F in the second sentence. These are sparse 2D image measurements, not precise 3D pitch/yaw or dense motion tracking.

mouth_observations: Both clips have a broad opening around 4.00 seconds and a narrower mouth near 4.48 seconds during never.
Both have rounded mouth shapes near 4.64-4.80 seconds around the end of never and sold.
At 4.92 seconds K approaches a closed-lip pose; F is narrow/pursed. Both reopen by 4.96-5.00 seconds around business, whose transcript onset plus measured audio delay is 4.973 seconds.
No clean uniform second-sentence mouth offset can be established from these sampled frames. This does not override the owner's moving-playback rejection.
Never and sold do not require a full bilabial lip closure. The v contact in never needs lower-lip/upper-teeth inspection, and exact phoneme timing is not supplied by the word transcript.
